items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: He would be featured in this number, My Josephine... They'd feature him in those numbers.

ctx.x: What did Pampas Alistair do? Would he just sit in a second and read or would he get it?

That's all. He would be featured in this number, My Josephine. That was his number, you know. He would feature him in that number. Muscat rambled. Didn't he rambled? Numbers like that. They'd feature him in those numbers. Did he sing then? He sang. I just understand, sang a number. I've forgotten the name of that number. He used to sing. He did used to sing a number. I've forgotten.
Did he get up and dance or shake it around on him then?
